decisions.reason: Because this close-to-core schlager compilation had its own page only in 2018 and 2019 and then disappeared despite industry growth, management would read it as performing below aspiration and reallocate shelf, inventory, and curation resources to stronger core lines.

Although it built on the established offer, the illustrated music release series was visible only in 2018 and 2019, suggesting results did not justify continued support relative to aspirations for a specialist retailer-label with limited slack.

The reissued jazz vinyl LP appeared only in its launch year, so under bounded rationality this is a clear weak signal that demand fell short of aspiration and the resources should be shifted to better-performing reissues or new searches.

The multi-disc box set showed up only in 2019, and for a mature German specialist merchant such higher-commitment physical editions would be dropped when follow-on evidence does not support keeping capital tied up.

Being only briefly mentioned in 2019 and never sustaining a stronger website presence, this compilation CD likely failed to meet aspiration levels and should be discontinued in favor of the established catalog and more promising developments.
